hypothesisInventory.researchQuestion: Within the exact baseline-001 formal stream, does a signal preceded by an opposite-direction immediately prior closed 1H candle have incremental H4 net edge versus all formal controls?
hypothesisInventory.falsifiableHypothesis: A fixed decision-time counter-move context may identify absorption or rejection before the formal signal; it must improve the frozen primary and robustness metrics versus CONTROL without a post-result rule change.
hypothesisInventory.economicRationale: A counter-direction candle immediately before a formal directional event can represent opposing inventory being absorbed before directional acceptance, creating a distinct entry-context state.
hypothesisInventory.whyItCouldCreateEdge: The rule isolates a discrete event-context conflict rather than the magnitude of the baseline score; if the conflict reflects exhaustion followed by acceptance, its conditional distribution may differ from the unfiltered formal stream.
hypothesisInventory.pointInTimeAvailability: Only the signal event and the exact preceding fully closed 1H candle are read; the prior candle must end at signalTime - 1_HOUR_MS and no candle after signalTime is eligible.
hypothesisInventory.expectedSampleBreadth: Potentially broad because the predicate is a binary adjacent-candle topology, but actual breadth is intentionally unknown until a separately authorized metadata-only preflight.
hypothesisInventory.expectedRegimeSymbolCoverage: All five frozen symbols and both directions remain in the population; all three frozen BTC regimes are reporting strata and must satisfy fixed breadth gates if present.
hypothesisInventory.implementationComplexity: Low: exact identity lookup plus one mirrored open/close comparison on the existing accepted closed-candle cache.
hypothesisInventory.leakageRisk: Low if exact prior identity, closed status, and signal-time cutoff are enforced; missing or ambiguous prior-candle provenance fails closed.
hypothesisInventory.overlapWithR13R18: Not an R13 feature-family model, not R14 replay logic, not R15 beta/alpha, not R16 microstructure, not R17 thesis lifecycle, and not R18 component positivity or score reweighting.
hypothesisInventory.falsifiableFailureCondition: G01-G07 failure, or failure of any frozen future H4 absolute, incremental, fold, cost, latency, or drawdown gate; no fallback cohort is permitted.
hypothesisInventory.whyNotTuningOrHindsight: Exactly one rule is frozen before preflight and performance; it has no numeric threshold, no scan, no optimizer, no parameter alternatives, and classification never reads labels or outcomes.
hypothesisInventory.candidateRule: CONTROL && ((direction === LONG && priorClosed1h.close < priorClosed1h.open) || (direction === SHORT && priorClosed1h.close > priorClosed1h.open))

hypothesisInventory.whyItCouldCreateEdge: A new formal state may represent an information update rather than persistence.
hypothesisInventory.pointInTimeAvailability: Potentially PIT from the formal replay stream.
hypothesisInventory.expectedSampleBreadth: Unknown and likely fragmented by state transitions.
hypothesisInventory.expectedRegimeSymbolCoverage: Requires every frozen symbol and regime.
hypothesisInventory.leakageRisk: Low technically, but high protocol-overlap risk.
hypothesisInventory.overlapWithR13R18: Structurally overlaps R17 thesis lifecycle and signal novelty work.
hypothesisInventory.falsifiableFailureCondition: Any overlap with R17 identity/lifetime semantics or structural breadth failure.
hypothesisInventory.whyNotTuningOrHindsight: Rejected before performance because novelty cannot be established without reusing R17 state semantics.

hypothesisInventory.whyItCouldCreateEdge: A directionally aligned market state may reduce adverse beta exposure.
hypothesisInventory.pointInTimeAvailability: PIT from the frozen regime function.
hypothesisInventory.expectedSampleBreadth: Likely broad but divided by market state.

hypothesisInventory.whyItCouldCreateEdge: A persistent calendar composition could alter execution conditions.
hypothesisInventory.expectedSampleBreadth: Likely fragmented and vulnerable to calendar concentration.

hypothesisInventory.researchQuestion: Does a formal event accompanied by a range-expansion context contain incremental information?

hypothesisInventory.whyItCouldCreateEdge: A large displacement may distinguish accepted movement from ordinary events.
hypothesisInventory.expectedSampleBreadth: Unknown and likely sensitive to a range definition.

activeHypothesis.researchQuestion: Within the exact baseline-001 formal stream, does a signal preceded by an opposite-direction immediately prior closed 1H candle have incremental H4 net edge versus all formal controls?
activeHypothesis.noveltyClaim: A single adjacent-candle body-direction conflict at decision time; no score, grade, lifecycle, beta, microstructure, compression, range threshold, or economic filter.
selectionBasis: point-in-time identity is exact and auditable
no parameter search or fallback variant

sourceUniverse.controlDefinition: Every accepted R14-native observation whose exact accepted-source baseline-001 replay satisfies the frozen formal predicate.

candidateDefinition.definition: Retain only an existing baseline-001 formal control event when the exact immediately preceding closed 1H candle body is opposite to the event direction.
candidateDefinition.pseudoExpression: CONTROL && ((direction === LONG && priorClosed1h.close < priorClosed1h.open) || (direction === SHORT && priorClosed1h.close > priorClosed1h.open))
allConditions: LONG requires prior close < prior open
SHORT requires prior close > prior open
missing, duplicate, malformed, or ambiguous prior candle => PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE
forbiddenAlternatives: nearest timestamp or fuzzy candle match
fallback rule when prior candle is missing

baselineFormalProvenance.requiredProvenanceCheck: git cat-file/git show accepted commit blobs and exact SHA-256 bytes before using working-tree files

definitions.requirement: Exact accepted R14 population/manifest and baseline formal source identity; every formal control event has exactly one valid prior closed 1H candle identity from the accepted existing cache; missing, duplicate, malformed, or ambiguous identity is PROVENANCE_INCOMPLETE; no network or reconstructed source.

Candidate classification uses only signal-time identity and the immediately preceding fully closed 1H candle; prior closeTime and openTime must satisfy the frozen UTC identity; no future candle or label is read.
Candidate H4 economically eligible label-status count is >= 500; status is inspected but economic value is not read during structural preflight.
Candidate H4 EXECUTED label-status count is >= 50 in each frozen validation fold F1-F6.
Candidate count is >= 20 for each of BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT, XRPUSDT, and BNBUSDT.
Candidate count is >= 50 in each BTC_STRONG_BULL, BTC_NEUTRAL, and BTC_STRONG_BEAR stratum using the frozen regime function.
0 < candidateCount < controlCount; candidate equal to CONTROL fails closed as ROUND-019 PERFORMANCE INELIGIBLE — NON-DISCRIMINATIVE SELECTOR.
Candidate mean >= CONTROL mean in >= 4 of 6 frozen validation folds.
Candidate meanNetForwardAtr > 0 in >= 4 of 6 frozen validation folds.
Candidate cost-stress mean >= 0 and cost-stress profit factor >= 1.05 under unchanged bt-policy-003.
Candidate latency-stress mean >= 0 and latency-stress profit factor >= 1.05 under the existing fixed latency stress.
Candidate maximum drawdown is not worse than CONTROL by more than 5% of abs(CONTROL maximum drawdown).

rules: performanceExecutionCount is derived from the round-global ledger and cannot be supplied by a caller
